tools.name: draw_cards
tools.description: Draws a specified number of cards from a shuffled standard 52-card deck using a cryptographically secure random source. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: generate_random_color
tools.description: Generates a random color in hexadecimal format (e.g., #A3F2B1) using a cryptographically secure random source. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: generate_password
tools.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random password with specified length and character type requirements (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: generate_random_number
tools.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random integer within a specified range (inclusive). Uses a secure random source. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: generate_username
tools.description: Generates a unique username by combining first name, last name, and birth year with a random suffix using a cryptographically secure random source. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: generate_random_string
tools.description: Generates a random string of specified length from a given character set using a cryptographically secure random source. Returns the generated string. (cost: 1 credit)

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "generate_password" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
